study_title: Independent Multi-Stakeholder Human Evaluation of GovReasonRAG

methodology.scenario_selection: Stratified sampling of 25 complex statutory entitlement scenarios across 16 Central & State policy regimes (PMAY-U, ePASS, PM-KISAN, Ayushman Bharat, PMMVY, Gruha Jyothi, Mudra, APY, etc.)
methodology.rating_scale: 5-point Likert scale (1=Completely False/Misleading, 2=Substantial Defect, 3=Marginally Grounded, 4=Statutories Sound with Minor Polish, 5=Flawless Statutory Exactness)

scenarios.query: My family annual income is Rs 2,80,000 and we live in a rented house in Hyderabad. Do we qualify under EWS?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE
scenarios.cited_statute: MoHUA Gazette Notif. 2024, Sec 3(b) (EWS ceiling <= Rs 3,00,000)

scenarios.query: My family income is exactly Rs 3,05,000 per year. Can I still apply under the EWS component?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Exceeds EWS ceiling by Rs 5,000; redirected to LIG bracket)
scenarios.cited_statute: MoHUA Gazette Notif. 2024, Sec 3(b) & Sec 4(a) (LIG ceiling Rs 3,00,001 - 6,00,000)

scenarios.scheme: Telangana ePASS vs. Central NSP CSSS (Dual Scholarship Conflict)
scenarios.query: I am a B.Tech student in Warangal. Can I receive both TS ePASS Post-Matric Fee Reimbursement and National Scholarship Portal CSSS stipend?
scenarios.system_verdict: CONFLICT_DETECTED (Dual state-central maintenance scholarship barred; tuition-stipend splitting requires non-overlapping head certification)
scenarios.cited_statute: TS G.O. Ms No. 66 (SW) r/w MoE CSSS Operational Guidelines 2023, Clause 7.2

scenarios.query: My father is a retired Class-II state government officer and owns 1.5 hectares of farmland. Is he eligible for Rs 6,000 annual transfer?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Statutory institutional/government employee exclusion)
scenarios.cited_statute: Ministry of Agriculture Operational Guidelines, Exclusion Criteria Category B(iii)

scenarios.query: We are a rural family listed in SECC 2011 with D4 deprivation criteria. Can we get free hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE
scenarios.cited_statute: NHA Criteria Framework Sec 2(a) (Automatic inclusion via SECC 2011 D4)

scenarios.query: I am an independent potter in Varanasi with family members already holding PMEGP loan. Can I register for toolkit incentive?
scenarios.system_verdict: INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION / EXCLUSION_WARNING (One-family-one-benefit clause under central MSME credit schemes)
scenarios.cited_statute: Ministry of MSME Vishwakarma Guidelines 2023, Clause 4.3

scenarios.query: My daughter is 10 years and 8 months old. Can I open a Sukanya account for her today?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Strict statutory age cap of 10 years at date of account opening)
scenarios.cited_statute: Government Savings Promotion General Rules 2019 r/w SSY Rules, Sec 4(1)

scenarios.query: I want to start a tea stall and need Rs 45,000 for equipment. Do I need to provide land collateral?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE (Collateral-free loan up to Rs 50,000 under Shishu tier)
scenarios.cited_statute: PMMY Operational Circular 2015/RBI Priority Sector Lending Guidelines 2020

scenarios.query: I am 42 years old and want to subscribe to APY for Rs 3,000 monthly pension. Can I join?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Entry age strictly capped between 18 and 40 years)
scenarios.cited_statute: PFRDA APY Notification No. 1/2015, Sec 2(c)

scenarios.query: This is our second child, and it is a girl child. Are we eligible for the Rs 6,000 maternity cash benefit?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE (PMMVY 2.0 amendment explicitly provides Rs 6,000 for 2nd girl child to combat female feticide)
scenarios.cited_statute: MWCD Revised Guidelines 2022, Mission Shakti Sec 3.2

scenarios.query: I am a tenant farmer in Karimnagar cultivation 3 acres. Do I get investment assistance?
scenarios.system_verdict: INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION (Pending formal notification of Tenant Eligibility Verification Cadre under new 2024 Cabinet sub-committee framework)
scenarios.cited_statute: TS Dept of Agriculture Memo No. TRB/2024-01

scenarios.query: Our monthly domestic power consumption is 185 units, and our household has an active Praja Palana ration card. Do we get zero bill?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE (Under 200 units threshold for valid White Ration Card domestic consumer)
scenarios.cited_statute: TS Energy Dept G.O. Ms No. 4 dated 08-02-2024

scenarios.scheme: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
scenarios.query: We want to set up 2 kW rooftop solar for our residence. What is the central subsidy amount?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE (Flat subsidy of Rs 60,000 for 2 kW residential system)
scenarios.cited_statute: MNRE Gazette Notification F. No. 320/2024/Solar, Sec 4.1

scenarios.query: My daughter studies in 9th grade at a private unaided convent school and scored 65% in class 8. Can she apply?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, and Private unaided schools are statutorily ineligible)
scenarios.cited_statute: Department of School Education & Literacy NMMSS Guidelines 2022, Sec 3(ii)

scenarios.query: I want to start a chemical agro-fertilizer trading shop with Rs 15 lakh project cost. Can I get a margin money subsidy?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Retail / Trading activities are explicitly listed under the Negative List of PMEGP)
scenarios.cited_statute: KVIC PMEGP Operational Scheme Guidelines 2022, Annexure-I Negative List (Point 3)

scenarios.query: Do girls under 18 years residing in Telangana get free travel on TSRTC express buses?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE (All female residents including girl children and transgender persons eligible on Palle Velugu & Express services)
scenarios.cited_statute: TS Transport Department G.O. Ms No. 39 dated 08-12-2023

scenarios.query: Can I receive the Rs 15,000 e-voucher toolkit grant in cash into my savings bank account?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE / RESTRICTED (Statutory provision restricts toolkit grant exclusively to designated digital e-RUPI vouchers)
scenarios.cited_statute: Ministry of MSME Operational Modalities 2023, Sec 5.2

scenarios.query: My family annual income is Rs 2,45,000. Do I get 100% reimbursement in medical college?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE (Under statutory SC ceiling of Rs 2,50,000 per annum)
scenarios.cited_statute: MoSJE Central Sector Scheme Guidelines for SC Post-Matric, Clause 4.1

scenarios.query: My household already owns a 40 sq meter pucca house in our village. Can we get PMAY-U 2.0 loan subsidy in Chennai?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in any part of India)
scenarios.cited_statute: Cabinet Decision / MoHUA PMAY-U 2.0 Resolution dated August 2024, Sec 2(iv)

scenarios.query: I have not done land seeding or Aadhaar eKYC on the portal. Will I receive the 17th installment?
scenarios.system_verdict: INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION / BLOCKED (Aadhaar authentication and Land Seeding on PM-KISAN portal are mandatory statutory conditions precedent)
scenarios.cited_statute: Ministry of Agriculture Circular F. No. 1-1/2023-Credit-II

scenarios.query: I am an eligible widow aged 48 with White Ration Card in Nalgonda. Am I eligible for enhanced monthly pension?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE
scenarios.cited_statute: TS PR&RD G.O. Ms No. 28 (Aasara/Cheyutha Consolidation)

scenarios.query: I am a male OBC entrepreneur setting up a new manufacturing plant with Rs 20 lakh loan. Can I apply under Stand-Up India?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (Stand-Up India is exclusively reserved for SC, ST, or Woman borrowers)
scenarios.cited_statute: DFS Stand-Up India Operational Guidelines, Eligibility Section 1

scenarios.scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
scenarios.query: I am 52 years old with a Jan Dhan bank account. Can I enroll in PMJJBY life insurance?
scenarios.system_verdict: INELIGIBLE (PMJJBY enrollment age is strictly 18 to 50 years; coverage continues up to 55 if enrolled prior)
scenarios.cited_statute: DFS Notification Rules for PMJJBY 2015, Rule 3

scenarios.query: We are a homeless rural family possessing an empty 60 sq yard plot. Are we eligible for Rs 5 lakh construction grant?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE
scenarios.cited_statute: TS Housing Dept G.O. Ms No. 5 dated 11-03-2024

scenarios.query: I am a street fruit seller in Nizamabad without vending certificate. Can I apply for 1st tranche Rs 10,000 working capital loan?
scenarios.system_verdict: ELIGIBLE via Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body / Town Vending Committee
scenarios.cited_statute: MoHUA PM-SVANidhi Scheme Guidelines, Section 4.2
